initiative.title: The Verse engine: what the worlds need next
initiative.body: Engine upgrades that worlds built on the Verse are waiting for. Each task names the projects and tasks that need it.

milestones.title: What Planetary Villa needs from the engine
milestones.body: Upgrades Hecate's Cemetery is blocked on; each links back to its Planetary Villa tasks.

milestones.title: Everglade at parity with the previous engine
milestones.body: What the Rust Verse engine's Everglade had that the Coax one doesn't yet. The reference is verse/everglade/previous/ (copied from 0b401561a0^, before the Nuke).

tasks.title: The water system from the previous Verse engine
tasks.body:
Port the whole water system of the previous Rust Verse engine to Coax: everything verse/everglade/previous/water.md specifies and the old engine shipped (phases W1 to W11: the coupling with physics, the shaders per tier, the spectrum, the clipmap, the shared clock, and what floats, swims and splashes), and the coast that reused it (verse/everglade/previous/coast.md, C1). Read the old code with `git show 0b401561a0^:<path>` (the paths in those files). Then Everglade's river and shore use it.

Released 2026-10-29 (the owner, on Everglade's fountain: "build whatever is needed from the water epic until this gets replaced"). Done: W1, W2, W3, W6's ripples, the painted preset and caustics; then the fountain, W4, W5 and the rest of W6, each its own task.
acceptance: Every behaviour water.md lists as shipped in the old engine works in a realm on openagents.com, side by side with the old engine's captures
Desktop and phone stay inside their frame budgets
Everglade's river is drawn with it
coax test passes on the engine files touched

tasks.title: Water W1: the physics of water in Coax
tasks.body: Phase W1 of verse-water (#c278), the only phase the owner has released: port the previous engine's physics::water (git show b399fa2dbe:crates/physics/src/water/, the W1 commit of #10773) to Coax as an engine library: water bodies, the Gerstner surface with deterministic time, point queries, the flow grid, buoyancy, drag, currents and the ledger terms, with the old tests as Coax checks matching their expected values. The spec is verse/everglade/previous/water.md, "Coupling with crates/physics" and its W1 status. No rendering (W2), no Everglade river or swimming (W3), no realm changes.
acceptance: The old crate's water tests are ported as #test checks with the same scenes and expected values
coax/bin/coax test --library verse/water.coax --steps 500000000 passes
coax/bin/coax test --library verse/rigid.coax passes
docs/verse/water.md says what W1 covers and what is next

tasks.title: Water W2: the water shader on WebGPU
tasks.body: Phase W2 of verse-water (#c278), released by the owner 2026-10-29: port the previous engine's water.wgsl v1 (git show 32e4d59fc2:crates/verse-pbr/src/water/, the W2 commit of #10774) and its CPU side to the Coax WebGPU renderer: the Gerstner mesh, Schlick Fresnel, sky reflection, per-channel Beer-Lambert absorption over baked depth, baked shore foam, GGX sun glints, Henyey-Greenstein crest scattering, two-phase flow-advected detail and the presets (Jerlov water types). Driven by verse/water.coax's WaveSet and FlowGrid on the same deterministic clock: the shader's angles come from the integer phase counters. Desktop and phone quality levels (the old High/Medium and Low).
acceptance: The shader's Gerstner displacement matches verse/water.coax's water_at_rest within a millimetre (a #test on the CPU mirror)
Presets parse and stay in range (#test)
coax test passes on the files touched
Drawn in a realm on openagents.com at desktop and phone, inside the frame budget

tasks.title: Water W3: Everglade's river uses the water system
tasks.body: Phase W3 of verse-water (#c278), adapted to today's Everglade (verse/everglade/plan.coax: a 4 m river the length of the world, one bridge at the river crossing). The river becomes a W1 river body with its level profile and generated flow field (water_flow_river), drawn with W2; its bed is carved into the ground; the player wades and swims (verse/player.coax keeps its land speeds), holds breath under water, and ducks and lily pads float on it by buoyancy. plan.coax's reachability checks say deliberately what the river now allows.
acceptance: coax test passes on plan.coax, the river and everglade.coax
The river is drawn with the W2 shader at /realms/everglade#river on desktop and phone, inside the phone triangle budget
Wading and swimming work; breath runs out under water; floating props ride the surface
The reachability checks record whether swimming across is allowed

tasks.title: Water W6 (part): ripples, your wake and splash
tasks.body: From phase W6 of verse-water (#c278), only the ripple field and the player's wake and splash: expanding rings from where you wade, swim or land in the river, foam riding young rings, as the old water.wgsl's ripple terms. Kelvin wakes of boats, debris, rowboats and spray stay for later.
acceptance: Ripples spread and fade (#test)
Walking into or swimming in the river leaves rings, landing in it splashes
coax test passes on the files touched

tasks.title: Water W7 (part): caustics on what lies under the water
tasks.body: From phase W7 of verse-water (#c278), only the caustics: the light the surface focuses onto what lies under the water, drawn on Everglade's river bed and banks (and later the fountain's basin) in the key's light and shadow, fading with depth. The rest of W7 (fog, the split waterline, distortion, sun shafts, motes, underwater audio) stays for later.
acceptance: Caustics drift on the river's bed in the shallows at /realms/everglade#river
They fade out with depth and in the key's shadow
Inside the phone frame budget

tasks.title: Water: Everglade's fountain on the water system
tasks.body: The commons' fountain (a flat 12-sided disc on a cream prism under a blue mushroom cap) becomes water: a carved stone basin and a column with an upper bowl (lathed stone, coursed and weathered, wet below the waterline), its pool and the upper bowl's drawn by the water shader in the painted preset (depth bands, Fresnel sky, ripples, a soft foam line where water meets stone), water falling in streams from the upper bowl's lip with a splash ring and rings where they land, a jet from the top, and caustics on the basin floor. Phones stay at 60 fps.
acceptance: coax test passes on everglade.coax
The fountain at /realms/everglade#commons shows the basin, the column, the falling streams, the splash ring and the pool's caustics at desktop and phone
No hard outline where the water meets stone
Inside the phone triangle and frame budget

tasks.title: Water W4: spectral waves

Driven by the deterministic water clock as W1's waves are.
acceptance: The old W4 tests ported as #test checks
Drawn in a realm at desktop and phone inside the frame budget

tasks.title: Water W5: scene copies, refraction, reflection, contact foam and soft particles
tasks.body: Phase W5 of verse-water (#c278): the scene's colour and depth copied before the water (host.js), refraction of the bed through the surface, planar reflection on desktop (SSR on High), contact foam and soft edges where the water meets anything from the depth, and soft particles.
acceptance: The bed bends through the surface and things standing in the water get a foam line from the depth
Desktop and phone inside the frame budget
Pages without water draw as before

tasks.title: Everglade: each house its own plaster and roof colour
tasks.body: The previous Everglade gave every house a plaster and a roof colour from short palettes (layout::paint, verse/everglade/previous/everglade.md, Rendering), so its streets varied; ours draws every house in the kit's one cream and one terracotta. Each house picks a gentle multiplier for its plaster pieces and its roof from two five-colour palettes by its number.
acceptance: coax test passes on everglade.coax
Neighbouring houses on the road in and round the commons show different plaster and roof colours at noon on production
The style check still passes for Everglade

tasks.title: Everglade: wood smoke from the chimneys, the bakehouse and the smithy
tasks.body: The previous Everglade's wood smoke rose from the bakehouse's stack, the smithy's forge and the houses' chimneys (verse/everglade/previous/everglade.md, Layout). Ours has hearths indoors but no chimney on a roof and nothing rising. Chimneys on the roofs that have a hearth, and soft painterly smoke from them on the particle system, drifting with the wind; none on a phone's far houses.
acceptance: coax test passes on everglade.coax
Smoke rises from the chimneys at /realms/everglade#commons at noon and dusk, desktop and phone
Perf in the release walk holds 60 FPS

tasks.title: Everglade: songbirds, butterflies and frogs
tasks.body: The previous Everglade had pairs of songbirds circling, a frog hopping round each pond's bank, rats along Main Street and butterflies over the flower drifts (verse/everglade/previous/everglade.md, Layout). Ours has ducks, sitting cats and the companion flock. Butterflies over the flowers by day, songbirds in pairs over the town, a frog at each pond.
acceptance: coax test passes on everglade.coax
Butterflies over the flowers and birds over the commons at noon on production, desktop and phone
Perf in the release walk holds 60 FPS

tasks.title: Everglade: bunting, window boxes, signposts and ivy
tasks.body: The previous Everglade dressed its streets: bunting across Main Street, flower boxes under windows, signposts at the crossings, ivy on the old walls, painted shop signs and benches round the ponds (verse/everglade/previous/everglade.md, Layout). Ours has lamps on posts and nothing else on its streets.
acceptance: coax test passes on everglade.coax
Bunting, window boxes and signposts show on /realms/everglade#road and #commons on production
Inside the phone triangle budget
